SELECT d.id, d.department_id, d.name, d.role_type, d.title, d.gender, d.avatar, d.intro, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time, dep.name AS department_name, u.username AS username FROM doctor d LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ( SELECT MIN(u2.id) FROM sys_user u2 WHERE u2.doctor_id = d.id AND u2.deleted = 0 AND u2.role IN ('DOCTOR', 'PHARMACIST') )
AND (d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su WHERE su.doctor_id = d.id AND su.deleted = 0 AND su.role IN ('DOCTOR', 'PHARMACIST') AND su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ))
AND d.department_id = #{departmentId}
ORDER BY d.id ASC
SELECT id, department_id, name, role_type, title, gender, avatar, intro, status, create_time, update_time FROM doctor WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT dep.id, dep.status, dep.type FROM doctor d JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id WHERE d.id = #{doctorId} AND dep.status = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT dep.id, dep.status, dep.type FROM doctor d JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id WHERE d.id = #{doctorId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND deleted = 0
